info.title: Pure Insights Command Centre API
info.description:
REST API for the Pure Insights Command Centre: report health, ownership, alerting and Snowflake cost attribution.

This document is generated from the route registry in `apps/api/src/http/routes.ts`. Each operation is the same object that mounts the handler, validates the request and enforces the permission, so the specification cannot describe an endpoint that does not exist or omit one that does.

Real-time events are delivered over WebSocket (`/ws`) and Server-Sent Events (`/api/v1/stream`); see the AsyncAPI document.

Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

post.summary: Mint a single-use ticket for the WebSocket or SSE stream
post.description:
Browsers cannot send an Authorization header when opening a WebSocket or EventSource. Call this with your bearer token, then open the stream with `?ticket=`. The ticket works once and expires in 30 seconds.

Requires permission `alerts:read` (roles: Platform Admin, FinOps Analyst, Report Owner, Viewer).

post.description:
The integration point for the portal: one event per dashboard load or refresh, up to 1,000 per request. Authenticate with `X-API-Key` (service) or a bearer token holding `telemetry:ingest`. Each event is validated on its own; rejected events are listed in the response and the rest are processed. Give each event an `eventId` and a request can be resent safely after a timeout: events already processed are counted in `duplicates` and not applied again.

Requires permission `telemetry:ingest` (roles: Platform Admin).

get.summary: Live load time and refresh outcomes over the last hours
get.description:

Requires permission `reports:read` (roles: Platform Admin, FinOps Analyst, Report Owner, Viewer).

Row-level security: Report Owners only see their own reports.

Requires permission `warehouse:refresh` (roles: Platform Admin).

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Service key for the telemetry emitter.

value.description: Latest observed value (seconds for latency, streak length for refresh, minutes of silence for stale telemetry).

occurrences.description: Breaching observations folded into this alert.

healthyStreak.description: Consecutive healthy observations since the last breach. Above 0 on an open alert means it is recovering: the latest reading was fine but the alert has not cleared yet.

resolveAfter.description: Healthy observations in a row needed before this alert resolves.

value.description: Latest observed value (seconds for latency, streak length for refresh, minutes of silence for stale telemetry).

occurrences.description: Breaching observations folded into this alert.

healthyStreak.description: Consecutive healthy observations since the last breach. Above 0 on an open alert means it is recovering: the latest reading was fine but the alert has not cleared yet.

resolveAfter.description: Healthy observations in a row needed before this alert resolves.

escalated.description: True when the report has no owner, so the alert went to platform admins.

inBrief.description: True for the two conditions the case-study brief mandates.

warningThreshold.description: Latency: seconds above which a warning fires. Stale telemetry: minutes without a reading before the alert fires.

escalateAfter.description: Refresh: consecutive failures after which severity becomes critical.

resolveAfter.description: Consecutive healthy observations required before an alert auto-resolves (flap damping).

AlertStatus.description: firing: condition holds, nobody has taken it. acknowledged: condition holds, someone owns it. resolved: condition cleared.

actor.description: User email, or `system` for engine transitions.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

platform.description: Whole-platform reconciliation. Null for callers scoped to their own reports.

rowSeq.description: 1-based line number in the source file.

inBrief.description: Listed in the case-study brief. False = found by profiling.

LatencySeverity.description: Load-time tier: WARNING above 15 s, HIGH above 30 s, CRITICAL above 45 s (defaults).

recipient.description: Owner email, or `platform-admins` when the report has no owner or the matter is system-wide.

NotificationChannel.description: none: no webhook is configured, so notifications are recorded but not sent.

NotificationKind.description: unacknowledged: nobody took a high-severity alert within the escalation window, so it went to the platform admins. feed_silent: no telemetry is arriving at all.

NotificationStatus.description: pending: waiting to be delivered or retried. failed: gave up after the retry limit. skipped: no channel is configured, so it was only recorded.

orphanEncoding.description: How the source encoded "no owner": NAN_LITERAL or SENTINEL.

costAtRiskUsd.description: Monthly run-rate with nobody accountable. Null without `costs:read`.

OwnerSource.description: telemetry: owner as reported by the portal. assigned: set by an admin in the Command Centre.

status.description: WARN: an advisory check about the shape of the input did not hold. FAIL blocks start-up.

RefreshStatus.description: Outcome of the last automated refresh. UNKNOWN means the portal reported no outcome.

creditsAttributed.description: Method A. Null when the reported figure was quarantined.

creditsFullyLoaded.description: Includes the report's share of warehouse idle time.

snowflakeCostPerViewUsd.description: Unit cost per active view, attributed basis.

totalCostPerViewUsd.description: Unit cost per active view, fully loaded incl. AWS.

isCostImputed.description: True when the cost was estimated from execution time (Method C).

source.description: Where the cost model is read from. Set with WAREHOUSE.

lastRefreshError.description: Set when the last refresh failed. The previous data stays in service.

feedSilent.description: True when no telemetry at all has arrived for longer than the feed-silence window.

duplicates.description: Events whose `eventId` had already been processed. They are acknowledged and ignored, so an emitter can safely resend a batch after a timeout.

points.description: The most recent individual readings. Only returned for a single report.

WarehouseRefreshOutcome.description: refreshed: new data is live. unchanged: the warehouse has not been rebuilt since the last read. failed: the previous data stays in service.
